import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["city", "city"]
# Join df0 and df1 on 'city' column (inner join by default)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', on='city')

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema: ['city': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': float, 'driver_count': integer]
# From joined dataframe:
# - city: from join key
# - fare: from df1
# - ride_id: from df1
# - driver_count: from df0

# Ensure correct dtypes:
df_result = df_joined[['city', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']].copy()

# Convert types explicitly
df_result['city'] = df_result['city'].astype(str)
df_result['fare'] = df_result['fare'].astype(float)
df_result['ride_id'] = df_result['ride_id'].astype(float)
df_result['driver_count'] = df_result['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (primary key)
# Aggregations:
# - fare: mean (float)
# - ride_id: mean (float) (ride_id is float in target, so mean to reduce duplicates)
# - driver_count: max (integer, driver_count is integer, max to keep the driver count per city)
grouped = joined.groupby("city").agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "mean",
    "driver_count": "max"
}).reset_index()

# Ensure column order and types as target schema
grouped = grouped[["city", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]
grouped["city"] = grouped["city"].astype(str)
grouped["fare"] = grouped["fare"].astype(float)
grouped["ride_id"] = grouped["ride_id"].astype(float)
grouped["driver_count"] = grouped["driver_count"].astype(int)

# Write output
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
